title: Natural Q&A #9
summary: An hour-long personal Q&A covering NH's grandfather, studying after an easy school life, why he didn't convert to Islam, Stoicism, languages, his character-study persona, medicine and vaccines, training in the cold, holiday eating, quitting pro bodybuilding content, relationships, mental-health drugs and many lifestyle topics. Little training content, but it reveals his views on health, discipline and identity.
claims: He will never show his grandfather on camera to keep his private life private, but plans story videos about the mountains where his grandfather lives and where his life-changing moments happened
Gifted students who never had to study must become tough on themselves; lifting taught him he could not wait for others to raise the bar
To succeed in med school, study ahead of the curriculum and train your memory; students who only study what they are told flunk
Learning to work is itself a skill: four hours spent writing something you throw away still built the skill
If school is too easy, make your own challenge: aim to be the best, learn a language on your own or read during class

He wasn't born Muslim: at 15-16 he explored Islam seriously but could not accept giving up free will to Allah's plan; he considers himself Christian though not fully Catholic, as he dislikes needing grace to be saved
He discovered Stoicism himself: philosophy often feels familiar because people independently reach the same ideas
He rejects Stoicism's demonization of anger: ancient men were too fiery, but modern men are too soft and need their fire back
Stoicism did not change his life but confirmed it: before becoming stoic he was angry, jealous, anxious and projected his insecurities onto others
Stoicism is the key to confidence because it refocuses attention on yourself
A favourite manga panel, from Sun-Ken Rock, says the only thing we truly own is our body; sharpen it like a blade and develop the spirit inside it
He is a third of the way through reading Berserk for a channel analysis
He speaks English and French fluently and understands Spanish and Portuguese but cannot speak them well
Learning a foreign language, even one not used where you live, shapes the brain and lets you see ideas from more perspectives; teaching kids a language is a great investment
His harsh character-study persona is quarantined to that series; he admits he can be cruel in real life and uses vulgarity when it gets things done
Greg Doucett devolved into a clown because he loves money and lacks integrity; NH says his principles will keep him from doing the same
He refuses drugs while healthy but would change his stance if a pill were needed to survive; he is against select drugs, not all medicine
Medicine should be a last resort; overprescribing antibiotics for colds has created resistant bacteria
As a kid he had daily headaches while taking painkillers; now he gets one about twice a year and just waits it out so his body handles it
He is vaccinated against diseases that can kill him or loved ones but has never had a flu shot; he says he hasn't been sick since age 15, 13 years ago
His parents kept his tonsils and wisdom teeth, and he has never had a cavity, which he takes as proof the body knows what it is doing
Strength has many forms, such as a widowed mother raising three kids; physical strength is a performance value while hypertrophy is an aesthetic, artistic value
Getting bigger makes you mentally stronger and more confident because you are harder to dominate
He has had sleep paralysis and once tore a finger tendon struggling to break out of it
Lucid dreaming and astral projection don't interest him: real life is where you are in control, and there is still too much of this world to explore
He never studied a lifting degree because making money from his hobby could kill his passion
Introverts don't need to force friendships: learn your social battery and pull out to recharge; he has very few close friends and fares better alone with age
Best general advice: ignore others' opinions, build your identity and skills first, then open up to others
For a serious relationship, pursue only women who want to build something, know your deal-breakers and communicate openly rather than playing mysterious
For a garden gym in rainy England, build even a crude shed so the bar and platform stay dry, since squatting with a wet bar is a hazard
His own garage gym is at 20-30 degrees Fahrenheit for about six months a year
Adapt to training in the cold with cold showers and by going out lightly dressed in autumn (around 50 F) so tendons and muscles get used to it
Before cold sessions, eat thermogenic foods: more protein, and he finds raw garlic and onion help; good capillary density helps warm the body
He eats small portions; at holidays his family cooks a healthy dish and he just takes a second serving, eating sugar sparingly as empty calories
He used to watch every Olympia but stopped because enhanced bodybuilding content worsened his body dysmorphia and distracts from natural bodybuilding
A study found depressed people living with very industrious partners got worse because the help shamed them; support a partner with an eating disorder gently rather than pushing hard
Psychiatric medication is fine as a crutch to kickstart change, but becoming dependent on it for life causes problems
Stockpiling non-perishable food is not selfish; he believes the toilet-paper shortage was manufactured and stocks up himself
A two-week trip to India shocked him with caste discrimination and visible poverty, making him aware of his privilege in France
A child is better off with two parents, even same-sex ones, than one; he still thinks heterosexual couples should get adoption priority
Video game addiction is among the worst addictions, like caffeine, because people don't recognise it as one
For career choice, find school subjects you love, research the field and its cost, commit and avoid constant major pivots
Tyler1 is a gifted short lifter whose short limbs make him look huge and strong for his size
He used to live in a basic cabin and only needs a bed, a fridge and a gym
He doesn't watch the news, believing it lies, and rarely cites studies, preferring to give his own information
The 48 Laws of Power is a morally neutral, Machiavellian book worth reading, if only to learn to resist manipulation
Kids diagnosed with ADHD are often just energetic boys who need to move and lift; overprescribing psychiatric drugs to children is a tragedy
To start living life, let go of what you missed, then build social stamina step by step through clubs and social venues
Men must initiate relationships whatever their looks; he has been rejected 25-26 times or more, which was part of his development
If a bad childhood doesn't weigh on you, don't dig; if you feel a shadow, see a therapist and face it
Part of his family is Spanish and he has visited Spain every year for over 20 years
Dating apps favour women, inflate their standards and crush men's confidence; avoid them
Action is the only cure for overthinking
Baby vaccines are fine if spaced out rather than given as large cocktails at once
HEMA looks fun, but some practitioners would be better off lifting weights
